settings.target.about: When the command names one currency, like /cur 100 usd, and in the message menu. One code or several: RUB, EUR. RUB if empty.
settings.try.about: Type a sum, like 100 usd, and see the answer here.

settings.show_date.about: Adds a line with the date the rate was published.
settings.usage: Type /cur 100 usd rub in any chat: the command is not sent, the result is. Several currencies at once: /cur 100 usd rub eur. Codes (USD, EUR, CNY…), symbols ($ € ₽ ¥ £ ₸ ₴ ₺ ₹), names (dollar, euro, yuan…) and 100k work. Someone else's “250 €”: “Convert currency” in the message menu. Rates are updated once an hour.
